Exam Date & Time: 12-May-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech VI Semester  
  End Semester Examination - April / May -2025  
  MACHINE LEARNING [IT-4402]  
Marks: 50                                                                                 Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
1)           Explain the key phases of the Machine Learning life cycle in sequential order  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Given a dataset containing missing values, how would you handle them using different  
  imputation techniques? Provide a brief explanation                                         (5)  
  
2)              Given a dataset with two classes (pass/fail), how would you apply logistic regression to  
  predict the outcome? List the key steps involved.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         How do decision trees make predictions? Explain the role of entropy and information  
  gain in constructing a decision tree.                                                      (5)  
  
3)              Compare Chernoff and Hoeffding bounds. How do these bounds help in understanding  
  the concentration of probability distributions?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         In an online learning scenario, if an adversary selects the hardest possible examples at  
  each step, what strategies can be used to minimize the worst-case error?                   (5)  
  
4)              Explain the role of the "number of clusters (K)" in K-Means? How can you determine  
  the optimal value of K?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Given a high-dimensional dataset, describe the steps involved in applying PCA for  
  dimensionality reduction.                                                                  (5)  
  
5)              Suppose you have an MDP where an agent needs to decide the best action at each state.  
  How would you use the Bellman equation to compute the optimal policy?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Explain how LQR optimizes a system's control inputs using a quadratic cost function.       (5)  
  
-----End-----
